vo_open.text: She fell ten kilometers without a parachute.

vo.text: In 1972, Vesna Vulović, twenty-two, was working as a flight attendant.
A bomb went off in the baggage hold. The plane broke apart in the sky.
vo.cap: A *bomb* in the baggage hold. The plane *broke apart.*

vo.text: She fell ten thousand, one hundred and sixty meters.
Fractured skull. Broken legs. Broken vertebrae. But she was the only survivor of twenty-eight.
vo.cap: Fractured skull. Broken legs. The *only survivor* of *28.*

vo.text: Guinness recorded it as the highest fall ever survived without a parachute.
vo.cap: *Guinness:* highest fall ever survived *without a parachute.*
